name: Every Knee Shall Bow
overview: The Bible reveals that every knee will one day bow and every tongue confess the lordship of God and Jesus Christ, affirming His supreme authority over all creation. Isaiah proclaims God's unchanging decree that all will submit to Him in righteousness, a truth echoed in Romans and fulfilled in Christ’s exaltation above every name, as described in Philippians. This universal acknowledgment culminates in the visible return of Jesus, when all will recognize Him as the eternal and unchanging Savior, inspiring both worship and reverent awe.
